admin_update_repo_settings.yml.name: GitHub: Admin Repositories Settings
description: updates IaC repository General Settings and Rulesets

az_acr_delete.yml.name: ACR: Delete Docker Images
description: deletes Container Images specified by the workflow input

az_acr_push.yml.name: ACR: Docker Push
description: before pushing the Docker image, the branch name is resolved to replace `/` with `-` and the image is built with the resolved branch name
builds and deploys Docker images in multiple steps

az_acr_release.yml.name: ACR: Docker Push Release
description: builds and deploys Docker images in multiple steps

az_acr_test.yml.name: ACR: Docker Push Test
description: before pushing the Docker image, the branch name is resolved to replace `/` with `-` and the image is built with the resolved branch name
builds and deploys the test Docker Image used by the K8: Test workflow

az_fa_deploy.yml.name: Azure: Function App Deployment
description: builds and deploys the Azure Function App
currently used to deploy the self hosted GitHub Actions Runner Monitor

gh_delete_branch.yml.name: GitHub: Delete Branch
description: calls ACR: Delete Docker Image job, targeting the tag `:test-<feature/hotfix>`
deletes the feature/hotfix branch Container Images (`:<platform>-<feature/hotfix>`)
deletes the feature/hotfix branch
troubleshooting: this job will fail when the feature/hotfix branch is deleted manually

gh_release.yml.name: GitHub: Release
description: publishes a release on GitHub with the tag generated by the pre-release that triggered this workflow
deletes a pre-release on GitHub with the tag generated by the pre-release that triggered this workflow
runs in case of a release deployment failure
troubleshooting: after fixing the error that caused the release deployment failure, recreate the pre-release to trigger the release deployment again

gh_validate_release.yml.name: GitHub: Validate Release
description: validates the release tag generated by the pre-release that triggered this workflow, using a RegEx check for semantic versioning
troubleshooting: inspect the pre-release tag name and ensure it follows the RegEx check for semantic versioning

k8s_apply.yml.name: K8: Apply
description: generates a Kubernetes kustomization diff and applies it to the cluster
differs from the `k8s-deploy` job in that it applies the entire namespace, as opposed to application specific configurations

k8s_deploy.yml.name: K8: Cluster Deploy
description: deploys the application to the Kubernetes cluster
differs from the `k8s-apply` job in that it applied application specific configurations, as opposed to the entire namespace
uses Canary Deployment strategy

k8s_destroy.yml.name: K8: Destroy
description: deletes all __deployment__ and __service__ Kubernetes resources in the namespace configured by GitHub Actions Environment Variables

k8s_edit.yml.name: K8: Edit
description: updates the Kubernetes deployment image tags to the latest release
creates a new branch `automated-release-dev` and a corresponding Pull Request in `k8-cluster-cognition` repository
when a Pull Request already exists, deployment image tag updates are accumulated on the existing Pull Request

k8s_exec_env_pull.yml.name: K8: Execution Environments
description: pulls execution environment images inside the Kubernetes cluster

k8s_reload_secrets.yml.name: K8: Reload Secrets
description: recreates a secret in the Kubernetes cluster with the latest value from Azure Key Vault, specified by the workflow input (deployment name)
restarts a deployment in the Kubernetes cluster, specified by the workflow input (deployment name)

k8s_release.yml.name: K8: Release
description: calls GitHub: Validate Release job
calls ACR: Docker Push Release job
calls K8: Edit job
calls GitHub: Release job
forwards deployment status to the GitHub: Release job
calls GitHub: Delete Branch job

k8s_restart.yml.name: K8: Restart
description: restarts a deployment in the Kubernetes cluster, specified by the workflow input

k8s_test.yml.name: K8: Test
description: calls ACR: Docker Push Test job
runs `alemic upgrade` on the application that triggered this workflow

if an application that depends on `refinery-gateway` database changes (e.g. `refinery-tokenizer`) triggers this workflow, the `alembic upgrade` is run on the `refinery-gateway` database if the same test Docker Image tag exists
uses the test Docker Image generated by the ACR: Docker Push Test job to run tests in the Kubernetes cluster
uses the revision number generated in the first step to downgrade the database
troubleshooting: in case of a failed test, inspect the logs of this job to identify the issue and resolve it by updating the application code

in case this workflow corrupted [app.dev.kern.ai](https.//app.dev.kern.ai), manually run K8: Apply in [k8-cluster-cognition](https://github.com/code-kern-ai/k8-cluster-cognition/actions/workflows/k8s_apply.yml) to apply the latest container images available on dev
in case of a workflow failure (TBD), ignore the failure and proceed with Pull Request merge

pg_dump.yml.name: Postgres: Dump Database
description: generates a PostgreSQL dump of the database specified by the workflow input
the dump is stored in the Azure File Storage configured by GitHub Actions Environment Variables

pg_restore.yml.name: Postgres: Restore Database
description: restores a PostgreSQL dump of the database specified by the workflow input
the dump is downloaded from the Azure File Storage configured by GitHub Actions Environment Variables

pi_build.yml.name: Parent Images: Build
description: builds & pushes `refinery-parent-images:<branch>-<type>` to registry.dev.kern.ai

pi_matrix.yml.name: Parent Images: Matrix
description: creates a [Matrix Strategy](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/writing-workflows/choosing-what-your-workflow-does/running-variations-of-jobs-in-a-workflow) input for GitHub Action with the following structure:

pi_merge_submodule.yml.name: Parent Images: Submodule Merge
description: updates Parent Image repositories' submodule reference

pi_merge_parent_image.yml.name: Parent Images: Parent Image Merge
description: builds & pushes `refinery-parent-images:dev-<type>` to registry.dev.kern.ai
updates Application repositories' <type>-requirements.in and requirements.txt
troubleshooting: resolved by updating the package version in the Application repository's <type>-requirements.in file
worked around by manually performing the [requirements compilation](https://www.notion.so/kern-ai/Docker-Base-Images-9d858b002ff840d3b0a3e90ec61d4179?pvs=4#a4450704a486434083710ef071b48cdc)

pi_release.yml.name: Parent Images: Release
description: builds & pushes `refinery-parent-images:vX.X.X-<type>` to Docker Hub
updates Application repositories' Dockerfiles to use the new parent image (updates Application repositories' open PRs)

release_please.yml.name: OpenTofu: Release
description: generates a release Pull Request with CHANGELOG updates for the calling repository
requires Conventional Commits

tf_docs.yml.name: OpenTofu: Generate Docs
description: generates documentation for the OpenTofu module

jobs.name: tf-module-docs
steps: Render OpenTofu docs and push changes back to PR

tf_plan_apply.yml.name: OpenTofu: Plan/Apply
description: executes `tofu plan` on the repository that triggered this workflow
creates a destruction plan when the calling repository's GitHub Actions Environment Variable `TF_DESTROY` is set to `-destroy`
executes `tofu apply` on the repository that triggered this workflow, assuming that the `tofu plan` job has succeeded
troubleshooting: inspect the logs of the `tofu plan` job to identify the issue and resolve it by updating Infrastructure as Code (IaC) files
inspect the logs of the `tofu plan` job to identify the issue and resolve it by updating Infrastructure as Code (IaC) files
